In Malawi, poliovirus has been identified in the past year.
Travelers to Malawi are at increased risk of exposure to poliovirus.
Vaccine recommendations: Adults traveling to Malawi who received a complete polio vaccination series as children may receive a single lifetime booster dose of inactivated polio vaccine; travelers who are unvaccinated or not fully vaccinated should receive a complete polio vaccination series before travel. Children who are not fully vaccinated will be considered for an accelerated vaccination schedule.

added.summary_en: As of 10 October 2026, a total of 12 confirmed yellow fever cases, with four deaths, have now been reported in Venezuela during 2026; in the states of Aragua, Barinas, Delta Amacuro, La Guaira, Lara and Monagas. Yellow fever has also been detected in monkeys along the country's jungle corridors. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 17 October 2026, a total of 76,784 dengue cases (59,728 confirmed) and 81 deaths have now been reported in Peru during 2026. Serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2 and DENV-3 have been identified. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 17 October 2026, a total of 91,419 dengue cases (64, 333 confirmed) and 69 deaths have now been reported in Columbia during 2026. Serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4 have been identified. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 19 October 2026, a total of 121 yellow fever cases (19 confirmed), with three deaths, have now been reported in the Upper West Region of Ghana. The outbreak response, including an emergency vaccination campaign, continues. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 21 October 2026, a total of 4,004 suspected dengue cases (including 311 confirmed and 11 deaths) have been reported in Chad during 2026. Six provinces have been affected: Ennedi Ouest, Batha, N'Djamena, Ouaddaï, Sila and Wadi Fira. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 23 October 2026, 4,588 confirmed measles cases have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions in the United States, during 2026. This exceeds the number of cases reported for the whole of 2025 and is the highest number of measles cases reported in the US for 35 years. The highest number of cases have been reported in Pennsylvania (1,327), followed by South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on measles.

As of 27 October 2026, a total of 1,548 cases (227 confirmed cases and 30 deaths) have been reported in Zambia since the cholera outbreak was declared on 28 July 2026. Cases have been reported across 18 districts in six provinces with the highest numbers reported in Lusaka and Chibombo districts. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on cholera.
As of 19 October 2026, a total of a total of 70,140 dengue cases have been reported in India during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 14 October 2026, a total of 23 yellow fever cases, with 11 deaths, have now been reported in Côte d'Ivoire for 2026. An outbreak response, including an emergency vaccination campaign, is ongoing. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 23 October 2026, a second Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) death has been reported in Kenya. This second fatal case was a direct close contact of the first case imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. All nine confirmed Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases in Kenya are linked to this index case and there is no evidence of community spread. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

On 22 October 2026, French health authorities reported the first ever known case of Shamonda virus (SHAV) infection in a human. The case was severely immunosuppressed and died in early October. Some brain complications prior to his death were likely linked to the infection. It is thought that the individual contracted the virus following a bite from a midge in the East of France, where the virus has been been circulating in animals (mainly cattle) since spring/summer 2026. Local health authorities have advised there is no risk to the general population at present as this appears to be an isolated and exceptional case. Please see World Organisation for Animal Health for further details on Shamonda virus.

The World Health Organization have reported 1,669 suspected cases (71 deaths) of Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF) across Afghanistan, Jan-Sept 2026. 220 cases were reported in September alone. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on CCHF.

As of 14 October 2026, a total of 18 Usutu virus cases have been reported in seven regions of Italy during 2026. Of these, eight have been reported in Lombardy, three in Lazio, two in Veneto and Marche and one case in each of Emilia-Romagna, Friuli-Venezia Giulia and Piedmont.
One case of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) has been detected in Kenya, during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on polio.

added.title_en: Ebola disease in Nigeria ex Uganda & DRC
added.summary_en: On 20 October 2026, according to the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare of Nigeria, one case of Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) has been confirmed in the Federal Capital Territory, in a woman with a recent travel history to Uganda. According to the Ugandan Ministry of Health this individual had travelled through Uganda from DRC. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

On 15 October 2026, the US Embassy and Consulate in Morocco stated that on 28 September 2026, the Ministry of Health of Morocco reported a small diphtheria outbreak, with clusters in multiple regions in Morocco. Health teams are tracing contacts and providing preventive treatment and vaccines. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of seven cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Albania during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of seven cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Bulgaria during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of three cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Slovenia during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

removed.summary_en: As of 13 August 2026, a total of 13 cases of diphtheria and two deaths have been reported. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

Between 1 January and 23 August 2026, a total of 16,997 cases of diphtheria and 596 deaths have been reported. Most cases have been reported from Kano, Bauchi, Katsina, Borno and Sokoto states. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 28 September 2026, 125 locally acquired cases of chikungunya have been identified in France, in Tarn, Lot, Gard (Occitanie), Gironde, Landes (Nouvelle-Aquitaine), Val-de-Marne (Ile-de-France) and Var (Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.

In 2026, up to 23 September, two locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Kosovo, in two areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

removed.summary_en: In 2026, up to 23 September, 69 locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in North Macedonia, in five areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, 91 locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Romania, across 22 areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 21 September 2026, 117 autochthonous cases of West Nile virus have been recorded in Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur, Occitanie, Ile-de-France, Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Pays de la Loire and Centre-Val de Loire. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, four locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Germany. Cases have been reported from Berlin, Leipzig Kreisfreie Stadt and Rhein-Pfalz-Kreis. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, 44 cases of West Nile virus, including 5 deaths, have been reported in the Netherlands. Cases have been reported from South Holland, Utrecht, North Holland, North Brabant, Gelderland and Overijssel provinces. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 22 September 2026, a total of 47 confirmed locally acquired dengue cases have been reported for 2026 in Italy. The cases have been reported in Puglia (13), Tuscany (31), Lombardy (2), Campania (1) regions of Italy. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 17 September 2026, 37 cases of hepatitis A have been reported from four states: Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York and Pennsylvania. Cases are associated with consumption of raw/undercooked shellfish imported from Ecuador. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on hepatitis A.
Between 6 and 12 September 2026, one case of locally acquired chikungunya was reported in Florida, USA. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.

On 17 September 2026, a locally acquired case of chikungunya was reported. This is the first locally acquired case of chikungunya in Hong Kong in 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.
In August 2026, one new clade I mpox case was reported in Estonia. This is the first case of clade I mpox in Estonia. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.
In August 2026, one new clade I mpox case was reported in Iceland. This is the first case of clade I mpox in Iceland. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.
In August 2026, three new clade I mpox cases were reported in Malta. These are the first cases of clade I mpox in Malta. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.

Between 6 and 12 September 2026, 41 new cases of locally acquired dengue were reported in Florida, bringing the total for 2026 to 152. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

On 17 September 2026, one fatal case of malaria was reported in Schwanheim district, Frankfurt, Germany. The case was one of two cases of malaria, resident in the Schwanheim district. The case was believed to have been infected by a mosquito introduced from an endemic area by aircraft to Frankfurt Airport and neither worked at the airport or had recent travel history. The latest infections and death brings the total to eight infections and three fatal cases. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on malaria.

Those at increased risk include travellers who are unvaccinated or under-vaccinated visiting friends and relatives, those in direct contact with an infected person, long-stay travellers, and those visiting areas of poor sanitation. removed.summary_en: As of 23 August 2026, a total of 1,056 confirmed Lassa fever cases, with 7,580 suspected cases, six probable cases and 253 deaths, have been reported across 24 states in Nigeria for 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Lassa fever.

As of 24 August 2026, Marshall Island's Ministry of Health and Human Services has reported 17 confirmed dengue cases. DENV-1 has been confirmed in circulation. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 31 August 2026, a total of 112 confirmed dengue cases have been reported in Vanuatu since 14 June 2026. The outbreak remains active, with ongoing local transmission in affected communities across South-West Efate, Shefa Province. The most affected areas continue to be Erakor (31%), Port Vila (22%), Eratap (21%), and Pango (16%). DENV-1 has been confirmed as the circulating serotype. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 1 September 2026, a total of 407 human cases of West Nile virus have been reported across 40 states in the United States. Of these, 285 cases were reported to be the neuroinvasive form. The highest number of cases have been reported in Arizona (88 cases), California (66 cases) and Texas (46 cases). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

On 20 August 2026, a fatal case of diphtheria has been confirmed in a child in Palermo, Sicily. A second probable case has been reported in another child who is unwell and is a contact of the first case. A further ten family members are reported to have tested positive, but remain well. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 24 August 2026, 17,180 confirmed locally acquired cyclosporiasis cases, including two deaths have been reported in 48 states and the district of Columbia in the USA. A further 11,844 cases are under investigation.

As of 27 August 2026, a total of 35 measles cases have been reported in Sweden in connection with the Ukult festival which took place between 30 July and 2 August 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on measles.

As of 26 August 2026, five locally acquired cases of dengue have been reported in the Tarn and Herault (both in Occitanie), la Dordogne (Nouvelle-Aquitaine) and Bouches-du-Rhône (Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur) departments in France. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.
As of 26 August 2026, a total of 10 Usutu virus cases have been reported in five regions of Italy during 2026.

On 26 August 2026, Taiwan's Centers for Disease Control confirmed two locally acquired clade Ib mpox cases in 2026. These are the first locally acquired clade Ib mpox cases in Taiwan. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Mpox.

As of 26 August 2026, a total of 539 confirmed diphtheria cases have now been reported across Australia during 2026. The majority of cases have been reported in the Northern Territory (289 cases) and Western Australia (227 cases). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 20 August 2026, a total of 20 confirmed cases of dermatophilosis caused by Dermatophilus congolensis have been reported in Austria between 2025 and July 2026. This includes 18 cases reported in Vienna and two in Salzburg.
As of 20 August 2026, one confirmed case of dermatophilosis caused by Dermatophilus congolensis has been reported in Denmark.

As of 20 August 2026, a total of 70 confirmed cases of dermatophilosis caused by Dermatophilus congolensis have been reported in France. Cases were predominantly, but not exclusively, among gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men.

summary_ja: 情報源に TravelHealthPro（英国 NaTHNaC）と FORTH（厚生労働省検疫所）を追加しました。以降は毎月、CDC を含む3ソースそれぞれの流行情報・国別データの変更点を、ソース別にこの「新規更新」へ日付つきで要約します（誤訳防止のため CDC/THP は英語原文、FORTH は日本語原文を併記）。
初回公開。CDC Travelers' Health の全244目的地（うち242地域でデータ取得）と Travel Notice 24件を掲載しました。
